title: Measurability and L¹ bound of one rectifiable triple's integrand against a bounded continuous form
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and H := μHE[n] on ℝ^P. Let U, W, M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^P → NVector (Eucl P) n satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ. Assume CompactlyContainedOpen W U: W is open, closure W is compact, and closure W ⊆ U. Let ω : ℝ^P → Covector (Eucl P) n be continuous with tsupport ω ⊆ W, and let B ∈ ℝ with ‖ω(x)‖ ≤ B for every x ∈ ℝ^P (operator norm). Put G := M.indicator (x ↦ θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x))). Then G is H-a.e. strongly measurable, and ∫⁻ ‖G(x)‖ₑ dH(x) ≤ ofReal(B)·∫⁻_{M∩W} ofReal(θ(x)) dH(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (ω : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) n) (B : ℝ), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → CompactlyContainedOpen W U → Continuous ω → tsupport ω ⊆ W → (∀ x, ‖ω x‖ ≤ B) → AEStronglyMeasurable (M.indicator fun x => θ x * ξ x (ω x)) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ∧ ∫⁻ x, ‖M.indicator (fun y => θ y * ξ y (ω y)) x‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B * ∫⁻ x in M ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))
